text: WITH rev AS (SELECT SUM(product_price) AS revenue FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01'), cost AS (SELECT SUM(order_cost) AS total_cost FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01') SELECT rev.revenue - cost.total_cost AS gross_profit_2025, 100.0 * (rev.revenue - cost.total_cost) / rev.revenue AS gross_margin_pct FROM rev, cost
